headlines.text: On this day in 2024, FTR & Kingston stepped through the curtain for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.59 ? a well-worked match.
It was 2026 when Andrade El Idolo vs. Tomohiro Ishii closed out Collision, rated 7.45 ? a strong outing.

secondaries.text: That Saturday in 2026, Rosa & Statlander made their first appearance under the AEW banner as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.20.
